name: Boulder Deadfall Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

stealth.details: (trained); DC 0 to spot the balanced boulders

disable: DC 27 Crafting check (expert) or DC 25 Thievery check (expert) to find and disconnect the plate from the tipping mechanism
reset: Resetting the boulders in the trap is a labor-intensive project that takes 2 hours.

items.name: Deadfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area without taking care to avoid the hidden trigger plate

---

Effect Creatures within 10 feet of the cave entrance take 4d10+18 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

text: A weight-sensitive plate buried underneath sand pulls a boulder over a cliff ledge, causing it to fall on targets within the entrance.
